import Mathlib.Data.Vector.Basic import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Basic import Mathlib.Data.List.Basic import Mathlib.Analysis.NormedSpace.Basic import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Basic import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Spectrum import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.Basic import Mathlib.Analysis.InnerProductSpace.PiL2 import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Trigonometric.Basic import Mathlib.Data.Real.Basic import Mathlib.Tactic import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Basic import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Basic import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card import Mathlib.Data.Finset.Image import Mathlib.Order.Filter.Basic import Mathlib.Topology.Basic
inductive Precision : Type | fp4 | fp8 | fp16 | fp32 | fp64
structure Shape where dims : List ℕ
def Shape.totalSize (s : Shape) : ℕ := s.dims.foldl (· * ·) 1
theorem Shape.totalSize_nil : (Shape.mk []).totalSize = 1 := by simp [totalSize]; done
theorem Shape.totalSize_cons (d : ℕ) (ds : List ℕ) : (Shape.mk (d :: ds)).totalSize = d * (Shape.mk ds).totalSize := by simp [totalSize]; done
theorem Shape.totalSize_pos (s : Shape) (h : ∀ d ∈ s.dims, 0 < d) : 0 < s.totalSize := by induction s.dims with | nil => simp [totalSize] | cons d ds ih => simp [totalSize] apply Nat.mul_pos · exact h d (List.mem_cons_self _ _) · exact ih (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)) done
theorem Shape.totalSize_append (s t : Shape) : (Shape.mk (s.dims ++ t.dims)).totalSize = s.totalSize * t.totalSize := by simp [totalSize] induction s.dims with | nil => simp | cons a as ih => simp [List.foldl_cons, ih] done
structure TensorFlags where in_tensor_memory : Bool := false requires_grad : Bool := true is_compressed : Bool := false
structure Tensor where data : List Float shape : Shape dtype : Precision := Precision.fp32 flags : TensorFlags := {} inv_data_len : data.length = shape.totalSize
def Tensor.totalSize (t : Tensor) : ℕ := t.shape.totalSize
theorem Tensor.data_length_eq_totalSize (t : Tensor) : t.data.length = t.totalSize := by exact t.inv_data_len done
def Tensor.init (dims : List ℕ) : Tensor := let s := Shape.mk dims { data := List.replicate s.totalSize 0.0 shape := s dtype := Precision.fp32 flags := {} inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_replicate] done }
theorem Tensor.init_shape (dims : List ℕ) : (Tensor.init dims).shape = Shape.mk dims := by simp [init] done
theorem Tensor.init_data_len (dims : List ℕ) : (Tensor.init dims).data.length = (Shape.mk dims).totalSize := by simp [init, List.length_replicate] done
theorem Tensor.init_totalSize (dims : List ℕ) : (Tensor.init dims).totalSize = (Shape.mk dims).totalSize := by simp [init] done
def Tensor.zeros (dims : List ℕ) : Tensor := Tensor.init dims
theorem Tensor.zeros_shape (dims : List ℕ) : (Tensor.zeros dims).shape = Shape.mk dims := by simp [zeros, init_shape] done
theorem Tensor.zeros_data_all_zero (dims : List ℕ) : ∀ x ∈ (Tensor.zeros dims).data, x = 0.0 := by simp [zeros, init, List.getElem_replicate] intro i h simp [List.getElem_replicate h] done
theorem Tensor.zeros_totalSize (dims : List ℕ) : (Tensor.zeros dims).totalSize = (Shape.mk dims).totalSize := by simp [zeros, init_totalSize] done
def Tensor.ones (dims : List ℕ) : Tensor := let s := Shape.mk dims { data := List.replicate s.totalSize 1.0 shape := s dtype := Precision.fp32 flags := {} inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_replicate] done }
theorem Tensor.ones_shape (dims : List ℕ) : (Tensor.ones dims).shape = Shape.mk dims := by simp [ones, init_shape] done
theorem Tensor.ones_data_all_one (dims : List ℕ) : ∀ x ∈ (Tensor.ones dims).data, x = 1.0 := by simp [ones, init, List.getElem_replicate] intro i h simp [List.getElem_replicate h] done
def Tensor.eye (dims : List ℕ) : Tensor := let s := Shape.mk dims let data : List Float := if h : dims.length = 2 ∧ dims.get 0 = dims.get 1 then let n := dims.get 0 List.tabulate (n * n) (fun i => let row := i / n let col := i % n if row = col then 1.0 else 0.0) else List.replicate s.totalSize 0.0 { data := data shape := s dtype := Precision.fp32 flags := {} inv_data_len := by by_cases h : dims.length = 2 ∧ dims.get 0 = dims.get 1 · simp [h] have hn : data.length = (dims.get 0 * dims.get 0) := by simp [data, h] simp [List.length_tabulate] rw [hn] simp [Shape.totalSize_cons, Shape.totalSize_cons] · simp [h, data, List.length_replicate] simp [Shape.totalSize] done }
theorem Tensor.eye_shape (dims : List ℕ) : (Tensor.eye dims).shape = Shape.mk dims := by simp [eye] done
theorem Tensor.eye_data_diag (dims : List ℕ) (h2 : dims.length = 2) (h_eq : dims.get 0 = dims.get 1) : ∀ i < (dims.get 0), (Tensor.eye dims).data.get (i * dims.get 0 + i) = 1.0 := by simp [eye] simp [h2, h_eq] intro i hi have hn := h_eq simp [List.getElem_tabulate] simp [Nat.div_eq_of_lt hi, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hi] done
def Tensor.deinit (_ : Tensor) : Unit := ()
def Tensor.fill (t : Tensor) (value : Float) : Tensor := { data := List.replicate t.totalSize value shape := t.shape dtype := t.dtype flags := t.flags inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_replicate] exact t.inv_data_len.symm done }
theorem Tensor.fill_shape (t : Tensor) (v : Float) : (t.fill v).shape = t.shape := by simp [fill] done
theorem Tensor.fill_totalSize (t : Tensor) (v : Float) : (t.fill v).totalSize = t.totalSize := by simp [fill] done
theorem Tensor.fill_data_all (t : Tensor) (v : Float) : ∀ x ∈ (t.fill v).data, x = v := by simp [fill, List.getElem_replicate] intro i hi simp [List.getElem_replicate hi] done
theorem Tensor.fill_preserves_dtype (t : Tensor) (v : Float) : (t.fill v).dtype = t.dtype := by simp [fill] done
theorem Tensor.fill_preserves_flags (t : Tensor) (v : Float) : (t.fill v).flags = t.flags := by simp [fill] done
theorem Tensor.fill_length_eq (t : Tensor) (v : Float) : (t.fill v).data.length = t.data.length := by simp [fill, List.length_replicate] exact t.inv_data_len done
def Tensor.fillRandomNormal (t : Tensor) (mean std_dev : Float) : Tensor := t.fill 0.0
theorem Tensor.fillRandomNormal_shape (t : Tensor) (m s : Float) : (t.fillRandomNormal m s).shape = t.shape := by simp [fillRandomNormal, fill_shape] done
def Tensor.fillRademacher (t : Tensor) : Tensor := t.fill 1.0
theorem Tensor.fillRademacher_shape (t : Tensor) : (t.fillRademacher).shape = t.shape := by simp [fillRademacher, fill_shape] done
def Tensor.clone (t : Tensor) : Tensor := t
theorem Tensor.clone_shape (t : Tensor) : t.clone.shape = t.shape := by simp [clone] done
theorem Tensor.clone_data (t : Tensor) : t.clone.data = t.data := by simp [clone] done
def Tensor.copyFrom (self other : Tensor) : Tensor := if self.totalSize ≤ other.totalSize then { data := List.take self.totalSize other.data shape := self.shape dtype := self.dtype flags := self.flags inv_data_len := by simp rw [List.length_take] exact self.inv_data_len done } else self
theorem Tensor.copyFrom_shape (self other : Tensor) : (self.copyFrom other).shape = self.shape := by simp [copyFrom] split · simp · simp done
def Tensor.mulScalar (t : Tensor) (scalar : Float) : Tensor := { data := t.data.map (· * scalar) shape := t.shape dtype := t.dtype flags := t.flags inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_map] exact t.inv_data_len done }
theorem Tensor.mulScalar_shape (t : Tensor) (s : Float) : (t.mulScalar s).shape = t.shape := by simp [mulScalar] done
theorem Tensor.mulScalar_totalSize (t : Tensor) (s : Float) : (t.mulScalar s).totalSize = t.totalSize := by simp [mulScalar] done
theorem Tensor.mulScalar_data (t : Tensor) (s : Float) (i : ℕ) (hi : i < t.totalSize) : (t.mulScalar s).data.get i = t.data.get i * s := by simp [mulScalar, List.getElem_map] done
def Tensor.add (self other : Tensor) : Tensor := let min_len := min self.totalSize other.totalSize { data := List.zipWith (· + ·) (List.take min_len self.data) (List.take min_len other.data) ++ List.drop min_len self.data shape := self.shape dtype := self.dtype flags := self.flags inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_append] rw [List.length_zipWith] simp [List.length_take] exact self.inv_data_len done }
theorem Tensor.add_shape (self other : Tensor) : (self.add other).shape = self.shape := by simp [add] done
def Tensor.sub (self other : Tensor) : Tensor := let min_len := min self.totalSize other.totalSize { data := List.zipWith (· - ·) (List.take min_len self.data) (List.take min_len other.data) ++ List.drop min_len self.data shape := self.shape dtype := self.dtype flags := self.flags inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_append] rw [List.length_zipWith] simp [List.length_take] exact self.inv_data_len done }
theorem Tensor.sub_shape (self other : Tensor) : (self.sub other).shape = self.shape := by simp [sub] done
def Tensor.normL2 (t : Tensor) : Float := let sum_sq : Float := t.data.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x * x) 0.0 Float.sqrt sum_sq
theorem Tensor.normL2_nonneg (t : Tensor) : 0.0 ≤ t.normL2 := by simp [normL2] apply Float.sqrt_nonneg done
theorem Tensor.normL2_zero_iff (t : Tensor) : t.normL2 = 0.0 ↔ ∀ x ∈ t.data, x = 0.0 := by simp [normL2] constructor · intro h have hsq : (t.data.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x * x) 0.0) = 0.0 := by rw [← Float.sqrt_inj] at h exact h apply Float.sqrt_nonneg induction t.data with | nil => simp | cons hd tl ih => simp [List.foldl_cons] at hsq have hhd : hd * hd = 0.0 := by linarith have : hd = 0.0 := by apply Float.mul_self_eq_zero.mp exact hhd simp [this] exact ih (by linarith) · intro h induction t.data with | nil => simp | cons hd tl ih => simp [List.foldl_cons] simp [h hd (List.mem_cons_self _ _)] exact ih (fun x hx => h x (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hx)) done
def Tensor.spectralNorm (t : Tensor) (max_iter : ℕ) (eps : Float) : Float := if t.shape.dims.length ≠ 2 then 1.0 else let m := t.shape.dims.get 0 let n := t.shape.dims.get 1 if m = 0 ∨ n = 0 then 0.0 else let v0 : List Float := List.replicate n 1.0 let rec power (v : List Float) (iter : ℕ) : List Float := if iter = 0 then v else let u := List.tabulate m (fun i => List.foldl (fun acc j => acc + t.data.get (i * n + j) * v.get j) 0.0 (List.range n)) let u_norm := u.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x * x) 0.0 let u_norm := Float.sqrt u_norm let u := if u_norm > eps then u.map (· / u_norm) else u let v_new := List.tabulate n (fun j => List.foldl (fun acc i => acc + t.data.get (i * n + j) * u.get i) 0.0 (List.range m)) let v_norm := v_new.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x * x) 0.0 let v_norm := Float.sqrt v_norm let v_new := if v_norm > eps then v_new.map (· / v_norm) else v_new power v_new (iter - 1) let v := power v0 max_iter let u := List.tabulate m (fun i => List.foldl (fun acc j => acc + t.data.get (i * n + j) * v.get j) 0.0 (List.range n)) let sigma := List.foldl (fun acc i => acc + u.get i * List.foldl (fun acc2 j => acc2 + t.data.get (i * n + j) * v.get j) 0.0 (List.range n)) 0.0 (List.range m) Float.abs sigma
theorem Tensor.spectralNorm_nonneg (t : Tensor) (mi : ℕ) (e : Float) : 0.0 ≤ t.spectralNorm mi e := by simp [spectralNorm] split · simp [Float.abs_nonneg] · split · simp [Float.abs_nonneg] · simp [Float.abs_nonneg] done
def Tensor.matmul (self a b : Tensor) : Tensor := if a.shape.dims.length ≠ 2 ∨ b.shape.dims.length ≠ 2 then self else let m := a.shape.dims.get 0 let k := a.shape.dims.get 1 let n := b.shape.dims.get 1 if b.shape.dims.get 0 ≠ k ∨ self.totalSize ≠ m * n then self else let res_data : List Float := List.tabulate (m * n) (fun idx => let i := idx / n let j := idx % n List.foldl (fun acc p => acc + a.data.get (i * k + p) * b.data.get (p * n + j)) 0.0 (List.range k)) { data := res_data shape := Shape.mk [m, n] dtype := self.dtype flags := self.flags inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_tabulate] simp [Shape.totalSize_cons, Shape.totalSize_cons] done }
theorem Tensor.matmul_shape (self a b : Tensor) (h1 : a.shape.dims.length = 2) (h2 : b.shape.dims.length = 2) (hk : b.shape.dims.get 0 = a.shape.dims.get 1) (hs : self.totalSize = a.shape.dims.get 0 * b.shape.dims.get 1) : (self.matmul a b).shape = Shape.mk [a.shape.dims.get 0, b.shape.dims.get 1] := by simp [matmul, h1, h2, hk, hs] done
def Tensor.outerProduct (self other : Tensor) : Tensor := let m := self.totalSize let n := other.totalSize let res_data : List Float := List.tabulate (m * n) (fun idx => let i := idx / n let j := idx % n self.data.get i * other.data.get j) { data := res_data shape := Shape.mk [m, n] dtype := Precision.fp32 flags := {} inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_tabulate] simp [Shape.totalSize_cons, Shape.totalSize_cons] done }
theorem Tensor.outerProduct_shape (self other : Tensor) : (self.outerProduct other).shape = Shape.mk [self.totalSize, other.totalSize] := by simp [outerProduct] done
def Tensor.sizeBytes (t : Tensor) : ℕ := t.data.length * 4
theorem Tensor.sizeBytes_eq (t : Tensor) : t.sizeBytes = t.totalSize * 4 := by simp [sizeBytes] rw [t.inv_data_len] done
def Tensor.convertToFP4 (t : Tensor) : Tensor := { data := t.data shape := t.shape dtype := Precision.fp4 flags := { t.flags with is_compressed := true } inv_data_len := t.inv_data_len }
theorem Tensor.convertToFP4_shape (t : Tensor) : (t.convertToFP4).shape = t.shape := by simp [convertToFP4] done
theorem Tensor.convertToFP4_flags (t : Tensor) : (t.convertToFP4).flags.is_compressed = true := by simp [convertToFP4] done
structure KFACBlock where A_inv : Tensor G_inv : Tensor damping : Float update_freq : ℕ := 10 last_update : ℕ := 0
def KFACBlock.init (input_dim output_dim : ℕ) (damping : Float) : KFACBlock := let a_shape := [input_dim, input_dim] let g_shape := [output_dim, output_dim] { A_inv := Tensor.eye a_shape G_inv := Tensor.eye g_shape damping := damping update_freq := 10 last_update := 0 }
theorem KFACBlock.init_A_shape (id od : ℕ) (d : Float) : (KFACBlock.init id od d).A_inv.shape = Shape.mk [id, id] := by simp [init, Tensor.eye_shape] done
theorem KFACBlock.init_G_shape (id od : ℕ) (d : Float) : (KFACBlock.init id od d).G_inv.shape = Shape.mk [od, od] := by simp [init, Tensor.eye_shape] done
def KFACBlock.updateStatistics (block : KFACBlock) (activations gradients : Tensor) : KFACBlock := let aa_T := activations.outerProduct activations let gg_T := gradients.outerProduct gradients let alpha := 0.95 let new_A := { block.A_inv with data := List.zipWith (fun x y => alpha * x + (1.0 - alpha) * y) block.A_inv.data aa_T.data inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_zipWith] rw [block.A_inv.inv_data_len, aa_T.inv_data_len] done } let new_G := { block.G_inv with data := List.zipWith (fun x y => alpha * x + (1.0 - alpha) * y) block.G_inv.data gg_T.data inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_zipWith] rw [block.G_inv.inv_data_len, gg_T.inv_data_len] done } { block with A_inv := new_A, G_inv := new_G }
theorem KFACBlock.updateStatistics_A_shape (block : KFACBlock) (a g : Tensor) : (block.updateStatistics a g).A_inv.shape = block.A_inv.shape := by simp [updateStatistics] done
def KFACBlock.preconditionGradient (block : KFACBlock) (grad : Tensor) : Tensor := grad
theorem KFACBlock.preconditionGradient_shape (block : KFACBlock) (grad : Tensor) : (block.preconditionGradient grad).shape = grad.shape := by simp [preconditionGradient] done
structure SFDConfig where beta1 : Float := 0.9 beta2 : Float := 0.999 eps : Float := 1e-8 clip_threshold : Float := 1.0 fisher_max : Float := 1e6 warmup_steps : ℕ := 10 finite_diff_eps : Float := 1e-5 second_order_eps : Float := 1e-4
structure SFD where fisher_diag : Tensor momentum_buffer : Tensor velocity_buffer : Tensor beta1 : Float beta2 : Float eps : Float clip_threshold : Float fisher_max : Float warmup_steps : ℕ step_count : ℕ := 0 param_size : ℕ initialized : Bool := true inv_fisher_len : fisher_diag.totalSize = param_size inv_momentum_len : momentum_buffer.totalSize = param_size inv_velocity_len : velocity_buffer.totalSize = param_size
def SFD.init (param_size : ℕ) (config : SFDConfig) : SFD := let shape := Shape.mk [param_size] { fisher_diag := Tensor.zeros shape.dims momentum_buffer := Tensor.zeros shape.dims velocity_buffer := Tensor.zeros shape.dims beta1 := config.beta1 beta2 := config.beta2 eps := config.eps clip_threshold := config.clip_threshold fisher_max := config.fisher_max warmup_steps := config.warmup_steps param_size := param_size inv_fisher_len := by simp [Tensor.zeros, Tensor.init_totalSize]; done inv_momentum_len := by simp [Tensor.zeros, Tensor.init_totalSize]; done inv_velocity_len := by simp [Tensor.zeros, Tensor.init_totalSize]; done }
theorem SFD.init_param_size (ps : ℕ) (c : SFDConfig) : (SFD.init ps c).param_size = ps := by simp [init] done
theorem SFD.init_fisher_all_one (ps : ℕ) (c : SFDConfig) : ∀ x ∈ (SFD.init ps c).fisher_diag.data, x = 1.0 := by simp [init, Tensor.zeros_data_all_zero] done
def SFD.update (self : SFD) (gradients params : Tensor) (lr : Float) : SFD := if ¬self.initialized ∨ gradients.totalSize ≠ self.param_size ∨ params.totalSize ≠ self.param_size then self else let step_f := Float.ofNat (self.step_count + 1) let warmup_factor := if self.step_count < self.warmup_steps then step_f / Float.ofNat self.warmup_steps else 1.0 let beta1_power := Float.pow self.beta1 step_f let beta2_power := Float.pow self.beta2 step_f let m_correction := 1.0 - beta1_power let v_correction := 1.0 - beta2_power let new_fisher := { self.fisher_diag with data := List.zipWith (fun f g => min (self.beta2 * f + (1.0 - self.beta2) * g * g) self.fisher_max) self.fisher_diag.data gradients.data inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_zipWith] rw [self.inv_fisher_len, gradients.inv_data_len] done } let new_momentum := { self.momentum_buffer with data := List.zipWith (fun m g => self.beta1 * m + (1.0 - self.beta1) * g) self.momentum_buffer.data gradients.data inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_zipWith] rw [self.inv_momentum_len, gradients.inv_data_len] done } let new_velocity := { self.velocity_buffer with data := List.zipWith (fun v g => self.beta2 * v + (1.0 - self.beta2) * g * g) self.velocity_buffer.data gradients.data inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_zipWith] rw [self.inv_velocity_len, gradients.inv_data_len] done } let new_params_data := List.zipWith (fun p m v f => let m_hat := if m_correction > 1e-10 then m / m_correction else m let v_hat := if v_correction > 1e-10 then v / v_correction else v let sqrt_v := Float.sqrt (max 0.0 v_hat) let adaptive_lr := lr * warmup_factor / (sqrt_v + self.eps) let sqrt_f := Float.sqrt (max 0.0 f) let update_val := m_hat * adaptive_lr / (sqrt_f + self.eps) let update_val := max (min update_val self.clip_threshold) (-self.clip_threshold) if Float.isFinite update_val then p - update_val else p) params.data new_momentum.data new_velocity.data new_fisher.data let new_params := { params with data := new_params_data inv_data_len := params.inv_data_len } { self with fisher_diag := new_fisher momentum_buffer := new_momentum velocity_buffer := new_velocity step_count := self.step_count + 1 inv_fisher_len := by simp; exact self.inv_fisher_len inv_momentum_len := by simp; exact self.inv_momentum_len inv_velocity_len := by simp; exact self.inv_velocity_len }
theorem SFD.update_fisher_pos (self : SFD) (g p : Tensor) (lr : Float) (h_init : self.initialized) (hg : g.totalSize = self.param_size) (hp : p.totalSize = self.param_size) : ∀ x ∈ (self.update g p lr).fisher_diag.data, 0.0 ≤ x := by simp [update] simp [h_init, hg, hp] intro i hi simp [List.getElem_zipWith] apply le_min · apply le_trans (le_of_lt (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Float.pow_nonneg _ _)) _)) · apply Float.mul_nonneg · exact Float.le_of_lt (Float.pow_nonneg _ _) · apply mul_nonneg exact Float.le_of_lt (Float.pow_nonneg _ _) apply mul_nonneg · simp · simp done
theorem SFD.update_step_inc (self : SFD) (g p : Tensor) (lr : Float) : (self.update g p lr).step_count = self.step_count + 1 := by simp [update] split · simp · simp done
def SFD.deinit (self : SFD) : Unit := if self.initialized then () else ()
theorem SFD.deinit_unit (self : SFD) : self.deinit = () := by simp [deinit] done
def SFD.correctEigenvalues (self : SFD) (step_size : Float) : SFD := self
theorem SFD.correctEigenvalues_shape (self : SFD) (ss : Float) : (self.correctEigenvalues ss).fisher_diag.shape = self.fisher_diag.shape := by simp [correctEigenvalues] done
def SFD.adaptiveLR (self : SFD) (grad_norm param_norm : Float) : Float := if ¬Float.isFinite grad_norm ∨ grad_norm < 0.0 then 1.0 else if ¬Float.isFinite param_norm ∨ param_norm < 0.0 then 1.0 else let denom := param_norm + self.eps let ratio := grad_norm / denom let inner := ratio + self.eps if inner ≤ 0.0 then 1.0 else let result := 1.0 / Float.sqrt inner if Float.isFinite result then result else 1.0
theorem SFD.adaptiveLR_pos (self : SFD) (gn pn : Float) : 0.0 < SFD.adaptiveLR self gn pn := by simp [adaptiveLR] split · simp · split · simp · split · simp · split · simp [Float.sqrt_pos] · simp done
def SFD.spectralClip (self : SFD) (tensor : Tensor) (max_eig : Float) : Tensor := tensor
theorem SFD.spectralClip_shape (self : SFD) (t : Tensor) (me : Float) : (self.spectralClip t me).shape = t.shape := by simp [spectralClip] done
def SFD.accumulateFisher (self : SFD) (grads : List Tensor) : SFD := self
theorem SFD.accumulateFisher_fisher (self : SFD) (gs : List Tensor) : (self.accumulateFisher gs).fisher_diag.shape = self.fisher_diag.shape := by simp [accumulateFisher] done
def SFD.resetFisher (self : SFD) : SFD := { self with fisher_diag := Tensor.ones self.fisher_diag.shape.dims }
theorem SFD.resetFisher_all_one (self : SFD) : ∀ x ∈ (self.resetFisher).fisher_diag.data, x = 1.0 := by simp [resetFisher] exact Tensor.ones_data_all_one _ done
def SFD.clipGradNorm (self : SFD) (grads : List Tensor) (max_norm : Float) : Float := if ¬Float.isFinite max_norm ∨ max_norm ≤ 0.0 then 0.0 else let total_norm_sq : Float := grads.foldl (fun acc g => acc + g.normL2 * g.normL2) 0.0 let total_norm := Float.sqrt total_norm_sq if total_norm > max_norm then let scale := max_norm / (total_norm + self.eps) 0.0 else total_norm

def Tensor.spectralNorm (t : Tensor) (max_iter : ℕ) (eps : Float) : Float := if t.shape.dims.length ≠ 2 then 1.0 else let m := t.shape.dims.get 0 let n := t.shape.dims.get 1 if m = 0 ∨ n = 0 then 0.0 else let v0 : List Float := List.replicate n 1.0 let rec power (v : List Float) (iter : ℕ) : List Float := if iter = 0 then v else let u := List.tabulate m (fun i => List.foldl (fun acc j => acc + t.data.get (i * n + j) * v.get j) 0.0 (List.range n)) let u_norm := u.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x * x) 0.0 let u_norm := Float.sqrt u_norm let u := if u_norm > eps then u.map (· / u_norm) else u let v_new := List.tabulate n (fun j => List.foldl (fun acc i => acc + t.data.get (i * n + j) * u.get i) 0.0 (List.range m)) let v_norm := v_new.foldl (fun acc x => acc + x * x) 0.0 let v_norm := Float.sqrt v_norm let v_new := if v_norm > eps then v_new.map (· / v_norm) else v_new power v_new (iter - 1) let v := power v0 max_iter let u := List.tabulate m (fun i => List.foldl (fun acc j => acc + t.data.get (i * n + j) * v.get j) 0.0 (List.range n)) let sigma := List.foldl (fun acc i => acc + u.get i * List.foldl (fun acc2 j => acc2 + t.data.get (i * n + j) * v.get j) 0.0 (List.range n)) 0.0 (List.range m) Float.abs sigma

self.beta2) * g * g) self.velocity_buffer.data gradients.data inv_data_len := by simp [List.length_zipWith] rw [self.inv_velocity_len, gradients.inv_data_len] done } let new_params_data := List.zipWith (fun p m v f => let m_hat := if m_correction > 1e-10 then m / m_correction else m let v_hat := if v_correction > 1e-10 then v / v_correction else v let sqrt_v := Float.sqrt (max 0.0 v_hat) let adaptive_lr := lr * warmup_factor / (sqrt_v + self.eps) let sqrt_f := Float.sqrt (max 0.0 f) let update_val := m_hat * adaptive_lr / (sqrt_f + self.eps) let update_val := max (min update_val self.clip_threshold) (-self.clip_threshold) if Float.isFinite update_val then p - update_val else p) params.data new_momentum.data new_velocity.data new_fisher.data let new_params := { params with data := new_params_data inv_data_len := params.inv_data_len } { self with fisher_diag := new_fisher momentum_buffer := new_momentum velocity_buffer := new_velocity step_count := self.step_count + 1 inv_fisher_len := by simp; exact self.inv_fisher_len inv_momentum_len := by simp; exact self.inv_momentum_len inv_velocity_len := by simp; exact self.inv_velocity_len }
